description:
Full synthetic listing record with per-value provenance (method 'synthetic'). listing_id is dealer_key:VIN (as
returned by search_inventory) or the urn. The vehicle-to-store link is in listing.selling_location (link_status,
selling_location_id, candidates, flags such as group_site_lists_sister_store or multi_store_unstated); the dealer
block is the advertising dealer. For price and fees in a compact form, use get_price_breakdown.

listing_id.description: dealer_key:VIN from search_inventory, or the listing urn.
listing_id.title: Listing Id

name: get_listing
